response_texts: Hey, what's wrong with you, Mr. Ozwald? You don't look so good... Aren't you looking forward to Artaeum?
I didn't know... I should have realized it sooner...
Mr. Ozwald, what are you talking about?
...We've lost. There's nowhere to run.
This is what Love, I and We were. Oh, for we are those who are scorched by flowers in the stench of darkness and rot.
Our fates have already crossed. The repeating three, that is the third one who returns or the unwanted sixth one.
I shall return now. I ask you to extend the welcome to the We... To Love, to We, to I, in your body!
O World Eater, you too have been cursed by your own words.
Was this kalpa too much even for you to devour? Or are you merely imitating the Dreugh King?
However, this is convenient. I will use that stomach of yours for the sake of my Lord.
Ah, mud and filth... The smell of the song of life. Can you see the radiance of life?
I am a fake. And she is merely a remnant of the real thing. But still, I have found it... what was once Love!
Once you were I, and now We. I regret leaving you but my flower is destined to wilt here and now. This is Love, I and We!
Ja'zel has been crushing sinful orphans and unsold goods without a shred of mercy. For he believes it is all surely a good deed.
The Chick Trader must crush orphans like the male Chick. All to protect the pleasant night from Roosters like you.
People will sleep better tonight. This is what Love is! And so, you shall be trampled by the true Love's cruelty...
No wings, no claws, no fangs, oh little dragon. You are like a sluggish maggot. Yet still, I love you so.
We are but foetuses in a dream. We cannot live outside it. Soon you will know what is outside the stream and how harsh it is.
And then you will return to that man-cat's womb. You are too young to be born. And yet it is too late to die and be reborn.
Ooooh! This it. I guard it. They order me to.
Er... What's your name?
Groll. What your name?
I am Lalanoah. Um... Can you be my friend?
Ooooh! I become friend! Lalanoah and I friend.
It's nice to meet you, Groll.
Thank you, thank you.
What is it, Skoll? What happened?
What do you have here? This is a letter... from Ja'zel...
That Chick Trader! Oblivion take that cat!
Hey, what are you talking about? I want to chat, too...
No, this is adult talk. Little brats should be sleeping.
Aw, but I'm not a child anymore!
You're still a little brat. Go back to bed.
Groll! Groll! Come here!
What is it? Stop making such racket in the middle of the night...
Oh, Lalanoah? You shouldn't be up this late in the night!
But uncle Brandt is still up this late...
I'm fine because I'm a grown up Nord.
You shouldn't mimic uncle Brandt's bad habits. Do you want to be twisted like him when you grow up?
Well... Okay. I'll sleep.
Huh, harsh words...
Lalanoah is a good girl. You should follow her example, uncle Brandt.
A shiny sweet roll!
You have good eyes, young lady. This is a golden sweet roll made by the Dwemer.
Awesome! Is it edible? What does it taste like?
Unfortunately, you can't eat it because it's made of metal. Unless you're a dragon.
Could a dragon eat this sweet roll?
With their strong jaws and stomach, they could. Do you want to become a dragon?
Hmm... dragon scales aren't cute.
A pity. How disappointing...
Mudspawn sightings are confirmed around Ebonwall. These monsters are one of the reasons why these riots spread so much.
They rose from the ground during the riots. Be careful... they'll attack anyone except the Ashlanders.
It was a massive summoning. Judging by that, there is a very powerful witch controlling them.
They are similar to the ash spawn seen on Solstheim. Could they be related?
The Telvanni are secretive about them so I don't know the details, but we can say they're almost the same.
It's difficult for them to maintain their muddy bodies of ash and snow... It's also been reported that they consist of several solids melted together.
Is there any possibility that House Telvanni is involved in this case? I honestly don't want to deal with them...
I don't think they are... but, uh...
The Telvanni are capable of horrible things.
Bah, this isn't very lucrative. Has it come to this that thieves should earn gold like honest people?
Look, look, pussy cat! I won the bet!
Stop talking to yourself, handsome. The one who made the bet was also me, so that makes me a winner, too.
What? Doesn't that make me look like a fool, then! So, where does that leave the cheese wager?
Ah, what a coincidence! We have just the right person for that right here. Let them evaluate the cheese.
You're a clever little pussy cat, to think of that. Smarter even than Julianos!
Prince... Where did you go...?
All right, Lalanoah. Are you ready? Do you have everything?
I'm ready. Uncle Brandt, do you have everything, too?
Hey, it's me, right? A true Nord never forgets anything.
Look, my coin pouch is right here... no. Where is it?
Here is your coin pouch. You dropped it in the kitchen. Hold on to it more carefully, please.
Uncle Brandt, that was a bit awkward...
Come on, people learn from mistakes. And I'm never awkward.
Hey, Orlando, you're still the same as always. And I'm here again.
Ah, son of Rolf. You grew big since I last saw you. How's your father?
He died in a civil war long ago. Said it was a good time to fight and die. Stupid fool.
I'm sorry about that. But I see you're here with a child. Did you finally bind yourself in marriage?
Do you mean Lalanoah? She's my best friend's kid. I'm just taking care of her now.
Hmm, that's a bit boring. Well, browse as much as you like.
Yes, we'll do just that.
You there. Are you familiar with that pest?
I have a question for you. Come here.
I'm glad you understand. Please guide them when the time comes.
Is it idiocy or despair that drives you, hmm? It matters not. The curse has already seeped into your blood.
Surely, you must despise Ja'zel. That is most pleasing. For who would ever want to be loved by a monster like you?
But Ja'zel... Ja'zel alone will love you. Everything this one did, he did it for you.
That chick... It was Lalanoah, no? She was worried about you until the very end.
Khajiit will put her remains in your pocket so you won't be lonely at the bottom of this dark hole. This time, take better care of her, yes?
Your story lies out there, beyond the sea of ink. After that, you may live the rest of your life as you choose.
